parameters.query:
WITH target_workspace AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM job_hunter.workspaces
  WHERE slug = $1
    AND is_active
  LIMIT 1
),
candidate_data AS (
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'candidate_id', candidate.id::text,
    'workspace_id', candidate.workspace_id::text,
    'full_name', candidate.full_name,
    'email', candidate.email,
    'phone', candidate.phone,
    'location', candidate.location,
    'timezone', candidate.timezone,
    'target_roles', candidate.target_roles,
    'work_modes', candidate.work_modes,
    'salary_expectation_min', candidate.salary_expectation_min,
    'salary_expectation_max', candidate.salary_expectation_max,
    'salary_currency', candidate.salary_currency,
    'salary_period', candidate.salary_period,
    'raw_master_cv', candidate.raw_master_cv,
    'profile_facts', candidate.profile_facts,
    'skills', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', skill.id::text,
          'name', skill.normalized_name,
          'category', skill.category,
          'level', skill.proficiency_level,
          'years', skill.years_experience,
          'evidence', skill.evidence,
          'verification', skill.verification_status
        )
        ORDER BY skill.category, skill.normalized_name
      )
      FROM job_hunter.candidate_skills AS skill
      WHERE skill.candidate_id = candidate.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) AS payload
  FROM job_hunter.candidate_profiles AS candidate
  WHERE candidate.workspace_id = (SELECT id FROM target_workspace)
    AND candidate.is_active
    AND candidate.consent_to_process
    AND (candidate.retention_until IS NULL OR candidate.retention_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
  ORDER BY candidate.updated_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
prompt_data AS (
  SELECT jsonb_object_agg(
    prompt.prompt_code,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'prompt_version_id', prompt.prompt_version_id::text,
      'version', prompt.version,
      'model_route_code', prompt.model_route_code,
      'system_prompt', prompt.system_prompt,
      'structured_output_schema', prompt.structured_output_schema
    )
  ) AS payload
  FROM job_hunter.v_active_prompts AS prompt
  WHERE prompt.workspace_id = (SELECT id FROM target_workspace)
)
SELECT
  (SELECT payload FROM candidate_data) AS candidate,
  COALESCE((SELECT payload FROM prompt_data), '{}'::jsonb) AS prompts;

options.systemMessage: Jesteś agentem Scout. Twoją jedyną rolą jest wyszukiwanie i ekstrakcja aktualnych ofert pracy przy użyciu funkcji Web Search podłączonego modelu. Zwróć wyłącznie dane zgodne z podłączonym Structured Output Parser.

parameters.query:
WITH upserted AS (
  INSERT INTO job_hunter.job_postings (
    workspace_id,
    source_platform,
    external_id,
    external_url,
    company_name,
    job_title,
    location,
    work_mode,
    employment_type,
    salary_raw,
    salary_normalized_min,
    salary_normalized_max,
    salary_currency,
    salary_period,
    source_published_at,
    extracted_text_content,
    sanitized_text_content,
    processing_status,
    content_trust_status,
    prompt_injection_detected,
    security_signals
  ) VALUES (
    $1::uuid, $2, NULLIF($3, ''), $4, $5, $6, NULLIF($7, ''),
    $8, NULLIF($9, ''), NULLIF($10, ''), $11::numeric, $12::numeric,
    NULLIF($13, '')::char(3), NULLIF($14, ''), $15::timestamptz,
    $16, $17, $18, $19, $20::boolean, $21::jsonb
  )
  ON CONFLICT (workspace_id, dedup_hash)
  DO UPDATE SET
    external_url = EXCLUDED.external_url,
    location = EXCLUDED.location,
    work_mode = EXCLUDED.work_mode,
    employment_type = EXCLUDED.employment_type,
    salary_raw = EXCLUDED.salary_raw,
    salary_normalized_min = EXCLUDED.salary_normalized_min,
    salary_normalized_max = EXCLUDED.salary_normalized_max,
    salary_currency = EXCLUDED.salary_currency,
    salary_period = EXCLUDED.salary_period,
    source_published_at = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.source_published_at, job_postings.source_published_at),
    extracted_text_content = EXCLUDED.extracted_text_content,
    sanitized_text_content = EXCLUDED.sanitized_text_content,
    processing_status = EXCLUDED.processing_status,
    content_trust_status = EXCLUDED.content_trust_status,
    prompt_injection_detected = EXCLUDED.prompt_injection_detected,
    security_signals = EXCLUDED.security_signals,
    last_seen_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  RETURNING *
),
requirement_rows AS (
  SELECT
    upserted.id AS job_id,
    CASE
      WHEN element->>'type' IN ('MUST_HAVE', 'NICE_TO_HAVE', 'RESPONSIBILITY', 'CONSTRAINT')
        THEN element->>'type'
      ELSE 'RESPONSIBILITY'
    END AS requirement_type,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(
        left(
          regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(element->>'name', ''))), '[^[:alnum:]+#./ -]+', '', 'g'),
          160
        ),
        ''
      ),
      'unnamed'
    ) AS normalized_name,
    LEAST(5, GREATEST(1, COALESCE((element->>'importance')::integer, 3))) AS importance,
    left(COALESCE(element->>'evidence', element->>'name', 'unspecified'), 1000) AS evidence_text
  FROM upserted
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements($22::jsonb) AS element
),
saved_requirements AS (
  INSERT INTO job_hunter.job_requirements (
    job_id,
    requirement_type,
    normalized_name,
    importance,
    evidence_text,
    extraction_confidence
  )
  SELECT
    job_id,
    requirement_type,
    normalized_name,
    importance,
    evidence_text,
    0.800
  FROM requirement_rows
  ON CONFLICT (job_id, requirement_type, normalized_name)
  DO UPDATE SET
    importance = EXCLUDED.importance,
    evidence_text = EXCLUDED.evidence_text,
    extraction_confidence = EXCLUDED.extraction_confidence
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  upserted.id::text AS job_id,
  upserted.workspace_id::text AS workspace_id,
  upserted.source_platform,
  upserted.external_id,
  upserted.external_url,
  upserted.company_name,
  upserted.job_title,
  upserted.location,
  upserted.work_mode,
  upserted.employment_type,
  upserted.salary_raw,
  upserted.salary_normalized_min,
  upserted.salary_normalized_max,
  upserted.salary_currency,
  upserted.salary_period,
  upserted.source_published_at,
  upserted.sanitized_text_content,
  upserted.processing_status,
  upserted.content_trust_status,
  upserted.prompt_injection_detected,
  upserted.security_signals,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id', requirement.id::text,
        'type', requirement.requirement_type,
        'name', requirement.normalized_name,
        'importance', requirement.importance,
        'evidence', requirement.evidence_text
      )
      ORDER BY requirement.importance DESC, requirement.normalized_name
    )
    FROM job_hunter.job_requirements AS requirement
    WHERE requirement.job_id = upserted.id
  ), '[]'::jsonb) AS requirements
FROM upserted;

WITH saved_evaluation AS (
  INSERT INTO job_hunter.job_evaluations (
    job_id,
    candidate_id,
    prompt_version_id,
    overall_fit_score,
    hard_skills_score,
    experience_match_score,
    mandatory_requirements_met,
    application_decision,
    confidence_score,
    strengths,
    gaps,
    ats_keywords_found,
    evidence_map,
    strategic_reasoning,
    tailoring_recommendation,
    requires_human_review
  ) VALUES (
    $1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4::smallint, $5::smallint, $6::smallint,
    $7::boolean, $8, $9::numeric, $10::jsonb, $11::jsonb, $12::jsonb,
    $13::jsonb, $14, NULLIF($15, ''), $16::boolean
  )
  ON CONFLICT (job_id, candidate_id, prompt_version_id)
  DO UPDATE SET
    overall_fit_score = EXCLUDED.overall_fit_score,
    hard_skills_score = EXCLUDED.hard_skills_score,
    experience_match_score = EXCLUDED.experience_match_score,
    mandatory_requirements_met = EXCLUDED.mandatory_requirements_met,
    application_decision = EXCLUDED.application_decision,
    confidence_score = EXCLUDED.confidence_score,
    strengths = EXCLUDED.strengths,
    gaps = EXCLUDED.gaps,
    ats_keywords_found = EXCLUDED.ats_keywords_found,
    evidence_map = EXCLUDED.evidence_map,
    strategic_reasoning = EXCLUDED.strategic_reasoning,
    tailoring_recommendation = EXCLUDED.tailoring_recommendation,
    requires_human_review = EXCLUDED.requires_human_review
  RETURNING *
),
updated_job AS (
  UPDATE job_hunter.job_postings
  SET
    processing_status = CASE
      WHEN $8 = 'QUARANTINE' THEN 'QUARANTINED'
      WHEN $8 = 'DISCARD' THEN 'REJECTED_LOW_FIT'
      ELSE 'EVALUATED'
    END,
    prompt_injection_detected = prompt_injection_detected OR $17::boolean,
    security_signals = security_signals || $18::jsonb,
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  WHERE id = $1::uuid
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT saved_evaluation.id::text AS evaluation_id
FROM saved_evaluation;

WITH updated_job AS (
  UPDATE job_hunter.job_postings
  SET
    processing_status = CASE WHEN $3 = 'QUARANTINE' THEN 'QUARANTINED' ELSE 'FAILED' END,
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  WHERE id = $1::uuid
  RETURNING workspace_id
),
audit AS (
  INSERT INTO job_hunter.audit_events (
    workspace_id,
    actor_type,
    actor_ref,
    action,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    correlation_id,
    safe_metadata
  )
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    'MODEL',
    'application_critic',
    'artifact_rejected',
    'job_posting',
    $1::uuid,
    $2,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'verdict', $3,
      'summary', $4,
      'findings', $5::jsonb
    )
  FROM updated_job
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT 'recorded' AS result
FROM audit;

WITH previous_artifact AS (
  SELECT id, artifact_version
  FROM job_hunter.application_artifacts
  WHERE job_id = $1::uuid
    AND candidate_id = $2::uuid
  ORDER BY artifact_version DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
saved_artifact AS (
  INSERT INTO job_hunter.application_artifacts (
    job_id,
    candidate_id,
    evaluation_id,
    parent_artifact_id,
    artifact_version,
    status,
    tailored_resume_html,
    tailored_resume_text,
    cover_letter_text,
    email_subject,
    email_body_html,
    ats_targeted_keywords,
    claims_evidence,
    modifications_summary,
    content_hash
  ) VALUES (
    $1::uuid,
    $2::uuid,
    $3::uuid,
    (SELECT id FROM previous_artifact),
    COALESCE((SELECT artifact_version + 1 FROM previous_artifact), 1),
    'PENDING_REVIEW',
    $4,
    $5,
    $6,
    $7,
    $8,
    $9::jsonb,
    $10::jsonb,
    $11,
    repeat('0', 64)::char(64)
  )
  RETURNING *
),
created_review AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM job_hunter.create_hitl_review(
    $1::uuid,
    (SELECT id FROM saved_artifact),
    'telegram',
    INTERVAL '24 hours'
  )
),
updated_job AS (
  UPDATE job_hunter.job_postings
  SET processing_status = 'QUEUED_FOR_HITL',
      updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  WHERE id = $1::uuid
  RETURNING workspace_id
),
audit AS (
  INSERT INTO job_hunter.audit_events (
    workspace_id,
    actor_type,
    actor_ref,
    action,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    correlation_id,
    safe_metadata
  )
  SELECT
    updated_job.workspace_id,
    'N8N',
    'job_hunter_workflow',
    'hitl_review_created',
    'application_artifact',
    saved_artifact.id,
    $12,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'critic_verdict', 'PASS',
      'artifact_version', saved_artifact.artifact_version
    )
  FROM updated_job
  CROSS JOIN saved_artifact
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  saved_artifact.id::text AS artifact_id,
  saved_artifact.artifact_version,
  created_review.review_id::text AS review_id,
  created_review.approval_token
FROM saved_artifact
CROSS JOIN created_review;
UPDATE job_hunter.hitl_reviews SET external_message_id = $2, dispatched_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING id::text AS review_id, decision, dispatched_at;

WITH target AS (
  SELECT
    review.id AS review_id,
    review.job_id,
    review.artifact_id,
    artifact.candidate_id,
    job.workspace_id
  FROM job_hunter.hitl_reviews AS review
  JOIN job_hunter.application_artifacts AS artifact
    ON artifact.id = review.artifact_id
  JOIN job_hunter.job_postings AS job
    ON job.id = review.job_id
  WHERE review.approval_token_hash = job_hunter.sha256_hex($1)
    AND review.decision = 'PENDING'
    AND review.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  FOR UPDATE OF review
),
updated_review AS (
  UPDATE job_hunter.hitl_reviews AS review
  SET
    decision = $2,
    reviewer_ref = $3,
    reviewer_notes = CASE WHEN $2 = 'MODIFIED' THEN 'Requested changes from Telegram' ELSE NULL END,
    reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  FROM target
  WHERE review.id = target.review_id
  RETURNING review.id, review.job_id, review.artifact_id, review.decision
),
updated_artifact AS (
  UPDATE job_hunter.application_artifacts AS artifact
  SET
    status = CASE $2
      WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN 'APPROVED'
      WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN 'REJECTED'
      ELSE 'DRAFT'
    END,
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  FROM updated_review
  WHERE artifact.id = updated_review.artifact_id
  RETURNING artifact.id
),
updated_job AS (
  UPDATE job_hunter.job_postings AS job
  SET
    processing_status = CASE $2
      WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN 'APPROVED'
      WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN 'ARCHIVED'
      ELSE 'EVALUATED'
    END,
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  FROM updated_review
  WHERE job.id = updated_review.job_id
  RETURNING job.id, job.workspace_id
),
queued_event AS (
  INSERT INTO job_hunter.outbox_events (
    workspace_id,
    event_type,
    aggregate_type,
    aggregate_id,
    idempotency_key,
    payload
  )
  SELECT
    updated_job.workspace_id,
    'hitl.' || lower(updated_review.decision),
    'hitl_review',
    updated_review.id,
    'hitl:' || updated_review.id::text || ':' || lower(updated_review.decision),
    jsonb_build_object(
      'review_id', updated_review.id::text,
      'job_id', updated_review.job_id::text,
      'artifact_id', updated_review.artifact_id::text,
      'decision', updated_review.decision,
      'reviewer_ref', $3,
      'telegram_message_id', $4,
      'next_owner', 'mcp_orchestrator',
      'automatic_submission_allowed', false
    )
  FROM updated_review
  JOIN updated_job ON updated_job.id = updated_review.job_id
  ON CONFLICT (workspace_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
),
audit AS (
  INSERT INTO job_hunter.audit_events (
    workspace_id,
    actor_type,
    actor_ref,
    action,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    safe_metadata
  )
  SELECT
    updated_job.workspace_id,
    'HUMAN',
    $3,
    'hitl_' || lower(updated_review.decision),
    'hitl_review',
    updated_review.id,
    jsonb_build_object('telegram_message_id', $4)
  FROM updated_review
  JOIN updated_job ON updated_job.id = updated_review.job_id
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT decision FROM updated_review), 'INVALID_OR_EXPIRED') AS result_status,
  (SELECT id::text FROM updated_review) AS review_id,
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM queued_event) AS event_queued;

'Odrzucono pakiet.' : ($json.result_status === 'MODIFIED' ? 'Zapisano prośbę o poprawki.' : 'Decyzja jest nieważna lub token wygasł.')) }}

parameters.content: ## 1. START + KLUCZE (n8n Trial)\nNajpierw użyj `Manual Trial Start`. W `Job Hunt Config` wpisz publiczny adres MCP i Telegram Chat ID. W Credentials podepnij: OpenAI API, PostgreSQL, Telegram Bot API oraz MCP Bearer Auth. Sekretów nie wpisuj do JSON. Po teście możesz aktywować harmonogram.

## 2. Scout + bezpieczny import\nScout używa Web Search podłączonego modelu, zwraca ścisły JSON, a kod usuwa HTML, deduplikuje URL-e i wykrywa typowe próby prompt injection. Podejrzane oferty trafiają do kwarantanny.
## 3. Evaluator\nOddzielny agent porównuje wymagania z dowodami profilu. Polityka kodowa ponownie wymusza próg 75, MUST_HAVE i kwarantannę — model nie może samodzielnie ominąć bramki.
## 4. Tailor → Critic\nTailor pisze CV/list wyłącznie z dowodów. Kod sanitizuje HTML allowlistą. Niezależny Critic sprawdza fakty, bezpieczeństwo i kompletność przed utworzeniem przeglądu.

## 5. Human-in-the-Loop\nDopiero PASS Critica tworzy jednorazowy token i wiadomość Telegram. Zatwierdzenie zmienia stan na APPROVED oraz publikuje zdarzenie outbox dla MCP/Obsidiana. Workflow nigdy nie wysyła aplikacji sam.
## 6. Decyzje Telegram\nW `HITL Operator Config` wpisz swój liczbowy Telegram User ID. Token ma 60 znaków, więc prefiks A:/R:/C: mieści się w limicie 64 bajtów.

meta.architecture: MCP control plane; runtime capability match without model ranking; n8n bounded executor; PostgreSQL state; Telegram HITL; Obsidian via outbox
meta.modelSelection: single default selected for Trial; MCP retains logical routing authority
